purpose: Canonical format-support contract for Windows and Android.

countingPolicy.formatFamily: Count a canonical document family once; aliases and profiles do not increase the count.
countingPolicy.extensionAlias: Record aliases on the family entry.
countingPolicy.container: ZIP, 7Z, and RAR are container capabilities, not document reader families.
countingPolicy.primaryFamilies: Exactly 50 curated canonical families for product positioning and the 50+ claim.
countingPolicy.extendedFamilies: Safely implemented and fully functional formats outside the main 50.
countingPolicy.partialFamilies: Formats with known limitations (preview-only, extraction-only, incomplete layout fidelity, or device-dependent codecs).
countingPolicy.containerCapabilities: Container archive capabilities (ZIP, RAR, 7Z) for import inspection.
countingPolicy.fullySupported: A family is fully supported only after import, library metadata, cover or preview, reading, progress persistence, offline use, security, and both-platform acceptance evidence.
